'''2012 European Championship John Moorley LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Moorley]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Darthmoorley
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
